title: Département des Aigles (In the Crates)
summary: A museum of twelve eagles kept present but permanently unexhibited inside the browser's non-rendering vault.
mechanism: HTML <template> elements: their eagle SVGs are parsed into inert fragments that are present in the DOM (counted and measured live) but structurally never rendered, so the walls stay empty.
references: Marcel Broodthaers, Musée d'Art Moderne, Département des Aigles, Section des Figures (1968-72)
Marcel Broodthaers, "Ceci n'est pas un objet d'art" label
René Magritte, The Treachery of Images (1929)
